reviewed_by: Codex focused review for native Browser scope capacity
reason: The native capture proxy now accepts the Project policy's full validated allowlists, including a 0-10000 TCP port range. Three exact Rust cases cover the large-scope regression, bounded request enforcement, and authorization modes. The selected Core and frontend tests check saved policy normalization and range parsing; the selected Browser journeys cover settings modes and durable browser scope on desktop and mobile profiles.
exclusions: Unrelated suites and browser feature areas are excluded. Mock Playwright profiles do not execute the Tauri proxy. This Linux host cannot verify a packaged macOS WKWebView or a physical mobile browser; those product gates remain pending. No origin-sensitive UI code changed, so a separate LAN-origin check is excluded.
